provider: SDG&E (bundled service: SDG&E delivery + SDG&E generation)

periods._note: Hours are 0-23 = the hour starting at that time (16 = 4:00-4:59 PM). Period rules come from the TOU-DR1 tariff sheet, not the rates table; confirm against the tariff before demo.

weekdayMarchApril._note: In March and April, weekdays 10 AM-2 PM are also super off-peak.

care._note: Total adjusted CARE rate (35% CARE discount and surcharge exemptions already applied).

fera._note: FERA = 18% line-item discount on the bill (excluding base services charge), plus a lower base services charge.

baselineCredit_note: Credit applies to usage up to 130% of the household's baseline allowance (depends on climate zone and season); bills show the allowance.
communityPower_note: Most City of San Diego customers get generation from San Diego Community Power (SDCP). Their bill shows SDG&E delivery charges plus a PCIA line plus SDCP generation charges, so totals differ from these bundled rates.
